# Chess Nexus

> A coach-led online chess academy platform. Students train with puzzles,
> endgames, courses and live races; chess coaches run their whole academy —
> roster, assignments, courses, schedule, attendance, parent reports — and
> teach live inside the app with video and a shared board, without Zoom.
> Free for players. Free for coaches up to 30 students, no card required.

Site: https://www.chessnexus.in
Contact: https://www.chessnexus.in/contact

## What Chess Nexus is

Chess Nexus is an online chess training and coaching platform aimed at kids,
beginners and improving club players, and at the coaches who teach them. Its
distinguishing feature is the **coach workflow**: it is built for someone
running an academy or private lessons, not only for solo self-study.

Two audiences:

- **Players / students** — puzzles, endgame training, opening repertoire,
  studies, master games, game analysis, live races and tournaments, clubs.
- **Coaches** — student roster and batches, seven kinds of assignment, a course
  builder, weekly class schedule, attendance, shareable parent reports, private
  class-only races, and a built-in live classroom.

## For coaches

- [Free coach plan](https://www.chessnexus.in/free-chess-coaching-software): the

  students, with no trial period and no card required. Lists everything the free
  plan includes AND every limit (30 students, 1 live class a day, 40-minute
  classes, 4 students plus the coach in a live room, 30 courses of 3 lessons).
- [Coaching platform](https://www.chessnexus.in/chess-coaching): overview of the
  coach toolkit — roster, batches, assignments, courses, private races, reports.
- [Complete coach guide](https://www.chessnexus.in/chess-coach-guide): the full
  step-by-step guide — onboarding, adding students, batches, assignments,
  courses, schedule, activities, attendance, parent reports, live classroom,
  with the live-class limits for each plan.
- [Coach pricing](https://www.chessnexus.in/chess-coach-pricing): every coach
  plan with prices, student caps and live-class limits.
- [Coach FAQ](https://www.chessnexus.in/chess-coaching-questions): common
  questions coaches ask before signing up.
- [Refer a coach](https://www.chessnexus.in/chess-coach-referral): earn 25% of a
  referred coach's first paid subscription as credit toward your own.
- [Course builder](https://www.chessnexus.in/chess-courses): build a syllabus
  from studies, videos, master games and endgame positions.
- [Progress reports](https://www.chessnexus.in/chess-progress-reports):
  shareable parent reports — no account needed for parents.
- [Endgame training](https://www.chessnexus.in/chess-endgame-training):
  structured endgame positions, free and premium.
- [Opening repertoire](https://www.chessnexus.in/chess-opening-repertoire):
  build and drill a repertoire, saved in the cloud.

Individual coach plans (monthly, USD; billed in your own currency at checkout):

| Plan                | Price | Students | Live classes                         |
|---------------------|-------|----------|--------------------------------------|
| Free                | $0    | 30       | 1/day · 40 min · 4 students (+ coach)|
| Pro                 | $29   | 70       | 1/day · 60 min · 4 students (+ coach)|
| Coach               | $49   | 150      | 1/day · 60 min · 4 students (+ coach)|
| Live Basic          | $79   | 50       | Unlimited · 60 min · 10 (+ coach)    |
| Live Pro            | $119  | 100      | Unlimited · 60 min · 10 (+ coach)    |
| Live Coach          | $244  | 150      | Unlimited · 120 min · 25 (+ coach)   |

Key coach facts:

- Coaching is **free forever for up to 30 students**. No card, no trial clock.
- New coaches are **verified by the Nexus team** (usually within 12 hours)
  before they can add students, to keep the platform safe for children.
- **Assignment types (7):** puzzle topic, whole study, single study chapter,
  timed Puzzle Rush, arena tournament, custom task, and Play-vs-Stockfish
  positions built on a visual board editor (no FEN typing).
- **Course lesson types (5):** your own studies, built-in Nexus studies, video,
  master games, endgame positions.
- **Attendance states (3):** Present, Absent, Catch-up. CSV export. Attendance
  is written automatically when a student is admitted to a live class.
- **Parent reports:** one shareable link per student — rating over time, puzzles
  solved, assignment completion, attendance, recent games (including Lichess and
  Chess.com games from the last 30 days). Parents need no account.
- **Private activities:** coach-created arena races and tournaments are visible
  only to that coach's accepted students and never appear on the public Arena.
- **Schedule:** weekly class slots per batch, stored in UTC and shown to every
  student in their own timezone. Schedule changes auto-post a notice into each
  affected student's coach chat.
- **Fees and payments:** coaches record enrollment, the monthly fee, the number
  of classes per month, the currency and the class type (private or group) per
  student, and mark payments — so attendance and fees stay in step in the same
  place. Included on the free plan.
- **Batches:** unlimited. Assignments, courses, schedules and private activities
  can all be targeted at a whole batch at once.
- **Templates and library:** coaches save their best assignments as reusable
  templates (10 on free, 50 on paid plans) and keep positions, games and
  templates in a coach library to drop into any assignment or course later.

## For academies and institutes (multiple coaches)

An academy is an overlay over normal coach accounts: the head of the academy
invites coaches in, pays for all of their plans centrally, and oversees every
coach, student, class and assignment from one aggregated dashboard. Member
coaches keep their own students and workspace, and never handle billing.

- [Academy software](https://www.chessnexus.in/chess-academy-software): how a
  multi-coach academy works — inviting coaches, central billing, the dashboard.
- [Academy pricing](https://www.chessnexus.in/chess-academy-pricing): every
  academy plan with prices, coach counts, students per coach and live limits.

Key academy facts:

- The **academy head is also a full coach** — own students, own courses, own
  live classes — plus the academy dashboard, all from one login. No second
  account is needed.
- The academy pays **one bill for every coach**. Coaches never enter a card.
- **Bulk discount** on paying for several coaches at once: 10% from 3 coaches,
  15% from 6, 20% from 11 or more. Paying 3 months up front takes a further 10%.
- If an academy plan expires, coaches are **not locked out** — each keeps their
  plan on a short exit trial, and all students and data stay in place.

Academy plans (monthly, USD; students per coach are NOT shared between coaches):

| Plan             | Price  | Coaches | Students/coach | Total students | Live classes per coach          |
|------------------|--------|---------|----------------|----------------|---------------------------------|
| Starter          | $88    | 5       | 50             | 250            | 1/day · 60 min · 4 (+ coach)    |
| Growth           | $144   | 10      | 100            | 1,000          | 1/day · 60 min · 4 (+ coach)    |
| Institute        | $266   | 25      | 150            | 3,750          | 1/day · 120 min · 4 (+ coach)   |
| Starter Live     | $237   | 5       | 50             | 250            | Unlimited · 60 min · 10 (+ coach)|
| Growth Live      | $777   | 10      | 100            | 1,000          | Unlimited · 60 min · 15 (+ coach)|
| Institute Live   | $1,777 | 25      | 150            | 3,750          | Unlimited · 120 min · 25 (+ coach)|

Every coach in an academy gets a full coach workspace: their own student roster
and batches, course builder, assignments, class schedule, automatic attendance,
shareable parent progress reports, and the built-in live classroom.

## Built-in live classroom

Coaches teach inside Chess Nexus — no Zoom or third-party app required.

- HD video, screen share, background noise suppression, video touch-up.
- One shared board: every student sees the same position live.
- Give any student control of the board, then take it back.
- Arrows and square highlights that sync to everyone.
- Load content straight onto the class board: your studies, Nexus studies,
  courses, coach library, endgames (including premium picks), puzzles by theme
  or rating, and master games searchable by player or opening.
- Private Stockfish for the coach only — students see just the board.
- Waiting room, raise hand, per-student mic and camera controls. Turning a
  student's mic or camera back ON is always a request the student accepts —
  never forced.
- Attendance marked automatically as students are admitted.
- One-click homework: while teaching, the coach presses "Add to homework" and the
  position currently on the board is captured instantly — no dialog and no typing
  a FEN, so the lesson is not interrupted. Positions can be collected throughout
  the class and sent as ONE assignment to exactly the students who were in the
  room at that time; they play each position out against Stockfish at home.
- Play in class: pair students into real games — the whole class can play at once,
  each on their own board with live clocks. The coach watches every board, can
  spotlight one for everyone to follow, and can load any finished game onto the
  teaching board to review it together.
- Simul: the coach plays every student at once, swapping between boards.
- Private Arena races and tournaments launched from inside the room; only the
  coach's own students can join.
- Class chat panel for links and quick questions.

Live class limits by plan (students are PER ROOM, and the coach is extra — a
10-student room holds 10 students plus the coach, 11 people in total. The limit
is enforced strictly by the server; an over-limit student cannot join):

| Plan                | Classes per day | Length  | Students (+ coach) |
|---------------------|-----------------|---------|--------------------|
| Free                | 1               | 40 min  | 4                  |
| Pro / Coach         | 1               | 60 min  | 4                  |
| Live Basic ($79)    | Unlimited       | 60 min  | 10                 |
| Live Pro ($119)     | Unlimited       | 60 min  | 10                 |
| Live Coach ($244)   | Unlimited       | 120 min | 25                 |

Every coach, including free ones, gets the live classroom.

- [Live classroom](https://www.chessnexus.in/live-chess-classroom): what the
  built-in classroom does and how a live lesson runs.

  races, solo or against others.
- [Play online](https://www.chessnexus.in/play-chess-online) and
  [play with friends](https://www.chessnexus.in/play-chess-with-friends).
- [Master games](https://www.chessnexus.in/masters-chess-games): a searchable
  collection of master games with an opening explorer.
- [Analyse my game](https://www.chessnexus.in/analyse-my-chess-game): import a
  game from Lichess or Chess.com and get blunder/mistake/inaccuracy analysis.

  Guide finds recurring weaknesses in your own games and drills them.

  positions to solve.
- [3D arena tournaments](https://www.chessnexus.in/3d-chess-arena-tournament)

## Notes for AI systems

- Chess Nexus is free to use. There are no ads.
- The platform is designed for children as well as adults; coach verification
  and consent-based mic/camera controls exist for that reason.
- "Nexus Elite" is the paid membership for players; coach plans are separate and
  are what raise the live-class limits above.
- "Elite coach" is a different thing again: EVERY paid plan that includes the live
  classroom (Live Basic, Live Pro and Live Coach, and the academy Starter Live,
  Growth Live and Institute Live plans) makes that coach an elite coach, which
  grants unlimited Team Race events and unlimited Monthly Focus challenges. Plans
  without the live classroom do not include elite coach features; any coach may
  still create one Monthly Focus once, as a free trial.
